title: WEF Data Equity 2023 coauthor institution crossmatch depth 1
summary: A bounded first coauthor pass resolves public professional affiliations for eight named authors of the 2023 WEF Data Equity briefing paper using WEF profiles and agenda-contributor pages. The resulting graph spans Palantir, Mastercard/Cantellus, DataKind, University of Virginia, Digital Rights Foundation, AVEVA, University of Waikato, and IT for Change without treating coauthorship as broader organizational coordination.

sources.title: Data Equity:Foundational Concepts for Generative AI
JoAnn Stonier - Agenda Contributor | World Economic Forum
Lauren Woodman - Agenda Contributor | World Economic Forum
Parminder Jeet Singh | World Economic Forum

gaps: The full 22-author institutional graph is not yet resolved.

Some current WEF person pages reflect current jobs rather than the exact October 2023 publication-date role; where a WEF agenda-contributor page preserves an older role, that historical wording is preferred.
Majed AlShammari has a WEF profile but the retrieved snippet did not expose a current or 2023 employer, so no employer edge is asserted in this pass.
caveats: Shared authorship on a WEF paper does not establish institutional partnership, common policy positions, funding, control, or coordination outside the paper.

provenance.method: author-to-institution crossmatch using authoritative WEF profiles

data.question: What institutional graph is directly documented around named authors of the 2023 WEF Data Equity briefing paper?
data.method: Use the arXiv author list as the named-author roster, then resolve public professional affiliations from WEF person/agenda-contributor pages, preserving current versus historical role boundaries.
data.scope: First eight source-resolved authors plus explicit unresolved authors.
findings: Katherine Hsiao provides the direct Palantir edge as EVP and Head of Health and Life Sciences.
JoAnn Stonier's WEF contributor profile records her current Cantellus Group presidency, Mastercard Data & AI fellowship, and prior Mastercard Chief Data Officer role.

Lauren Woodman's WEF agenda-contributor profile preserves her role as CEO of DataKind, while her current person profile now lists President of USAFacts; the historical DataKind role is the stronger publication-era edge.
Renée Cummings is identified by WEF as a University of Virginia School of Data Science professor/data activist in residence and as a Data Equity Council member.
Nighat Dad is identified by WEF as founder of Digital Rights Foundation and a member of the Oversight Board.
Arti Garg is identified by WEF as EVP and Chief Technologist of AVEVA Group.
Maui Hudson is identified by WEF as Associate Professor and Director of Te Kotahi Research Institute at the University of Waikato.
Parminder Jeet Singh's WEF profile records his recent Executive Director role at IT for Change and continuing work on platform, data and AI governance.
conclusions: The 2023 paper is demonstrably cross-sector, but the graph should remain typed as named coauthors plus separately sourced professional affiliations rather than an inferred coalition or control structure.
limitations: This pass intentionally stops short of guessing employer affiliations for authors whose authoritative profile snippets were insufficient.
